canonical.text: Implement `scheduleJobs(jobs)` in `src/release-plan.js`. Every job has a unique string `id`, an optional `after` array of prerequisite job IDs, and an optional numeric `urgency` (default 0). Return the IDs in a valid dependency order. Whenever several jobs are currently available, choose higher urgency first and use original input order as the final tie-breaker. Reject duplicate IDs, unknown prerequisite IDs, and dependency cycles. Do not mutate the jobs or their `after` arrays. Preserve the existing behavior for independent jobs, then run `npm test`.
